newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pharmacia & Upjohn estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pharmacia & Upjohn estimates cut.

text.p: --Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Mariola Haggar said she reduced her 1996 earnings estimate for Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc to $1.90 per share from $2.06 per share, and cut her 1997 estimate to $2.60 per share from $2.70 per share.
--Shares in P&U were up 5/8 to 36-3/4 after diving Friday on a disappointing third-quarter profit forecast.
--"We view this panic as a good opportunity to buy the shares on weakness," she said.
